title: Elux Legend Lemon Mint Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Lemon Mint Nic Salt delivers the perfect balance of zesty citrus and invigorating minty freshness. The tangy, bright notes of Lemon are paired with a cooling burst of Mint, creating a smooth and refreshing vape that’s ideal for fans of sharp, clean flavour profiles. Elux Legend Nic Salts are double-concentrated to replicate the bold, intense flavours of Elux’s bestselling disposable vapes. With a smooth nicotine salt formula, these e-liquids provide near-instant nicotine relief with minimal throat irritation, making them ideal for vapers seeking an effective and flavoursome experience. Blended with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Lemon Mint Nic Salt is perfect for use with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and refillable pod systems. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, this e-liquid is designed to deliver vibrant flavour and smooth satisfaction for adult smokers and vapers alike.
